column1: Create Constraints,"Run once before loading. Paste all into Neo4j Browser and press Ctrl+Enter. NODE KEY needs Enterprise (Neo4j Desktop dev DBs are Enterprise)
column2: on Community, replace the Variant NODE KEY with separate IS NOT NULL + IS UNIQUE constraints.","CREATE CONSTRAINT department_id   IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Department)      REQUIRE n.department_id IS UNIQUE

column1: CREATE CONSTRAINT ward_id         IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Ward)            REQUIRE n.ward_id IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT patient_id      IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Patient)         REQUIRE n.patient_id IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT admission_id    IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Admission)       REQUIRE n.admission_id IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT specimen_id     IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Specimen)        REQUIRE n.specimen_id IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT sample_id       IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Sample)          REQUIRE n.sample_id IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT lab_result_id   IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:LabResult)       REQUIRE n.lab_id IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT antibiotic_id   IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Antibiotic)      REQUIRE n.antibiotic_id IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT organism_taxid  IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Organism)        REQUIRE n.taxid IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT refgenome_acc   IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:ReferenceGenome) REQUIRE n.accession_no IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT assembly_id     IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Assembly)        REQUIRE n.assembly_id IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT biodata_uri     IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:BioDataFile)     REQUIRE n.uri IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT contig_id       IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Contig)          REQUIRE n.contig_id IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT feature_locus   IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Feature)         REQUIRE n.locus_tag IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT seqrun_id       IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:SequencingRun)   REQUIRE n.run_id IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT vcr_id          IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:VariantCallingRun) REQUIRE n.process_run_id IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT variant_key     IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Variant) REQUIRE (n.REF_ACC, n.POS, n.REF, n.ALT, n.hgvs_c, n.hgvs_p) IS NODE KEY
CREATE CONSTRAINT tcr_id          IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:TaxonomicClassification) REQUIRE n.process_run_id IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT antibiotic_class IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:AntibioticClass) REQUIRE n.name IS UNIQUE
CREATE CONSTRAINT snomed_sctid     IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:SNOMED)          REQUIRE n.sctid IS NODE KEY
